mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 61 degrees and overcast skies over Reddan Soccer Park, with an air quality index of 51.

September is a significant month for local awareness. Mayor Diaz has proclaimed September as Hunger Action Month to fight food insecurity and Suicide Prevention Month to promote mental health resources. Also, please plan for travel delays as flagging on Highway M will be in place Monday and Tuesday for utility work.

There is plenty to do this weekend! Today you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol square, and tomorrow the Verona Area High School is hosting the Kids Triathlon. You can also catch the Girls Try Hockey event tomorrow at the Verona Ice Arena.
Checking in on the weekly police report, on August 23 at 1:54 AM, officers cited a 17-year-old for absolute sobriety and his passenger for underage drinking.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Mint Explosion. The store is currently preparing for the day and will open today at 10:00 AM.
